description: Get an instant price for printing a 3D model (STL, 3MF, or a zip containing them, max 300 mm on the longest side) and shipping it within Norway. Provide exactly one of file_url, file_base64, stl_text, upload_id (from create_upload_link) or file_id. Returns tilbud_id (the quote_id), total price in NOK with breakdown, estimated weight and print time, and bestill_url: a page where the user can order themselves. To order on the user's behalf, use create_order. The quote is valid for 14 days.

color.description: PETG: Svart, Hvit, Grå, Blå, Grønn, Rød. ABS: Svart, Hvit. Default Svart.

colors.description: Multicolour 3MF (Bambu Studio/OrcaSlicer) only: one of our colour names per colour slot in the file, in slot order. Omit to get the nearest available colours (shown in fargeplasser).

file_base64.description: The model file encoded as base64 (up to 30 MB; use create_upload_link for larger files).

file_id.description: fil_id returned by POST https://formnord.no/api/print/fil (multipart upload), for clients that can send HTTP themselves.

file_url.description: Direct https link to an .stl, .3mf or .zip file up to 500 MB (not a web page about the model; Thingiverse/Printables pages block automated downloads, so use create_upload_link for those).

infill.description: 15 = light (lightning infill, 3 walls; maps, figures, decor), 20 = standard (most parts), 40 = strong (load-bearing), 100 = solid.

material.description: PETG is the default and suits most parts. ABS for heat resistance.

stl_text.description: ASCII STL content, for small models you generated.

upload_id.description: upload_id from create_upload_link, after the user has uploaded the file.

zip_entry.description: If the file is a zip with several models: which one to quote (name from the list in the previous error).

name: get_print_quote

grunn.description: Human-readable reason (Norwegian) when ok is false.

kode.description: Machine-readable error code when ok is false.

pris.description: Price breakdown in NOK; pris.totalt is the total including shipping.

title: FormNord: pris på 3D-print
